# Copilot Instructions

<!-- Use this file to provide workspace-specific custom instructions to Copilot. For more details, visit https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/copilot/copilot-customization#_use-a-githubcopilotinstructionsmd-file -->

This is a minimalist portfolio website project with a black theme. The focus is on clean, readable code and a professional appearance without unnecessary visual clutter.

## Design Guidelines
- Maintain the black background (#000) and white text (#fff) color scheme
- Use minimal, subtle visual elements
- Ensure responsive design for mobile and desktop
- Keep animations and transitions simple and smooth
- Focus on typography and spacing for visual hierarchy

## Code Style
- Use semantic HTML5 elements
- Keep CSS organized and well-commented
- Maintain consistent naming conventions
- Ensure accessibility best practices
